title: Persona Craft
tagline: Steve enters the Metaverse: summon your Persona, keep building blocks.
description: Spawn in a Tokyo-style Metaverse inside Minecraft, awaken a Persona and use its skills in combat while placing and breaking blocks like always. Music and Persona content are read from your own copy of Persona 5 Royal.
firstMinute: Spawn in metaverse_tokyo, receive starter Persona, press summon key, cast first skill, place blocks.
v1Scope: P5R music read from player's install
